data.exact_reserve_text:
The estimate for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims are as follows:

Marine, aviation and transport	1.0	3.4
Fire and other damage to property	2.1	4.0
Third party liability	0.3	1.3
Miscellaneous	0.0	0.4

Favourable movement in technical provisions	3.4	9.1

The movement in estimate of the prior year incurred claims forms a 1% (2018: 2%) component of the 2019 loss ratio of 58% (2018: 53%).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 681.2m. Using the published gross claims development (claims triangle) the syndicate shows net adverse prior-year development of GBP 20.8m (3.05% of opening gross reserves) driven by adverse development in older years (notably the 2017 underwriting year) partially offset by favourable development in 2015 and 2016. The movement reflects a combination of favourable claims development in some vintage years and large-loss adverse development in others. No specific named prior-year catastrophes are quantified in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year incurred claims forms a 1% (2018: 2%) component of the 2019 loss ratio of 58% (2018: 53%).
Large loss case reserves are determined through careful analysis of the individual claim, often with the advice of legal advisers.
Property catastrophe claims such as earthquake or hurricane losses can take several months, or years, to develop as adjusters visit damaged property and agree claim valuations.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision' amount was located. Gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development (claims) triangle (page 26) by comparing the current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2015-2017 (2014 & prior excluded as an aggregate column). Net prior-year movement disclosed in the prior years' claims estimate note is +3.4m (favourable) but that is net of reinsurance; this JSON reports the GROSS movement derived from the triangle (+20.8m adverse). Lob-level prior-year movement amounts are not provided in the notes, so lob_movements is empty.
